title: Matrix block terminator
statement: For a Boolean list $x$ and natural numbers $n,i$, each $j$ with $i\le j<n^2$ has equal entries at indices $2n+2+2j$ and $2n+2+2j+1$. The entries at indices $2n+2+2n^2$ and $2n+2+2n^2+1$ are respectively false and true; out-of-range entries are treated as false.
hypotheses_covered: For every j with i≤j and j<n², the two specified entries are equal
